This dataset contains the three-hundred-and-eleven (311) scans of Turner Valley Gas Plant, National Historic Site. The data was collected by MiraCAD between May and October, 2020, with the Leica Scan Station P40 laser scanner. All data was registered and processed through Leica Cyclone v.2020 and saved in LAS format in CloudCompare v.2.9.1. The dataset covers the exterior and interior of multiple buildings that form part the Turner Valley Gas Plant.
